# Security Policy

Tuffgal is pre-1.0. There is no supported release line yet, so security
fixes land on `main` and ship in the next alpha.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately — do not open a public issue.

Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/nschneble/tuffgal/security/advisories/new)
to open a confidential advisory. If you can't use that, email
nick.schneble@hey.com with the details.

Include what you need to reproduce it: affected version, steps, and the
impact you observed. We'll acknowledge the report and follow up with a fix
or a plan before any public disclosure.
